Reconciliation added 46 identities and four recommendation dates; three-round review supported two inclusions and 48 scope exclusions, retaining their original HF dates. Three arXiv queries succeeded with zero results; 13 GitHub repositories had zero releases in the source window. All five RSS feeds succeeded, returning 58 window entries. entry.title: Follow RSI · 2026-11-12 · Collection and review bulletin
entry.summary: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 sources were attempted at 14:24–14:29 Asia/Shanghai. Today’s HF board was available with six papers, none meeting the Harness self-evolution criterion in item-level scope review; later additions remain possible. The complete Nov 11 and refreshed Nov 10 boards each contained 39 papers, with two late Nov 10 members. Across sources, 65 new identities (58 papers and seven official articles) received three-round review: six narrowly qualify and 59 are excluded, with no new unresolved scope cases. EmoHarness is assigned to its Nov 10 recommendation date, and RoboScript is assigned to the newly observed Nov 11 recommendation date after rechecking its original evidence; both are reviewed on Nov 12. LASER, SAT, RoboACE, FGSE and NCP enter historical-backlog review under their older source dates, not today’s new-paper count. NCP qualifies only as a control-rule admission framework and negative result: all actual candidates were rejected and the active policy did not change. ReTrace has real repair feedback and reuse, but produces an SOP task program replacing the agent rather than revising its own Harness. Three arXiv searches returned no window records; five RSS feeds returned 54; checks of 13 GitHub repositories found no window releases. S2 citations yielded 318 window records covering 285 identities, with traversal stopped at the time bound before all pages were read; the author source was rate-limited. Uncollected coverage remains unknown. Eighteen retries for nine older externally blocked bodies recovered none. Seventy-four author/comment metadata patches were verified against official sources while preserving scientific fields, first_seen and prior decisions. Version-review work remains individually recorded. Timestamp disagreements for RoboScript and TeX-tainted URL proposals are reported without changing source facts. New paid generation requests: zero. This is a collection-time status bulletin, with no new papers included today.

entry.title: Follow RSI · 2026-11-14 · Collection and review bulletin
entry.summary: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 sources were attempted starting at 10:46 Asia/Shanghai. HF returned an HTTP 200 empty list for Nov 14, a complete 34-paper Nov 13 board and a refreshed 21-paper Nov 12 board with one late member. All raw board members were reconciled. Across sources, 41 new identities were found: 37 arXiv papers, Semipy and three official posts. Three-round scope review recommends one inclusion, 39 exclusions and one evidence deferral. JustRUA qualifies narrowly through its Harness self-improvement experiment for a Nov 13 supplement reviewed on Nov 14; gains of the final static system are separate. Semipy has verified DOI and print/online dates, but its body returns 403 and its version and scope remain unresolved. Three arXiv searches returned zero window records, five RSS feeds returned 58, and checks of 13 GitHub repositories found zero window releases. S2 citations returned 411 window records across 300 identities before rate limits and the deadline; author queries were also rate-limited, so missing coverage is unknown. Of 39 historical version pairs compared, 24 reuse unchanged scope opinions and three have independent scope checks; 12 still require substantive reading. Across the task tables, 349 body-comparison tasks remain. TeleTune, EmbodiedEvo and ECG-RSI enter historical-backlog review at their current versions. Eighteen retries recovered none of nine older externally blocked bodies. The unpublished Harness Repair record and summary have been rebound to official v1 evidence; complete publication review is still deferred, without importing later-version numbers. The already-published 2611.08318 receives only its newly observed HF date, not duplicate publication. DeepMind article dates follow the official page and structured metadata, with conflicting RSS values retained. New paid generation requests: zero. This is a collection-time review bulletin, with no new papers included today.
